honest_c3: Non-stationarity AMPLIFIED with more axes: 1s↔12h tick spacing now mixes 6 sidecars sampled on totally different cadences (lint=daily, heartbeat=once, h100=per-pod-tick); MI estimator stationarity assumption maximally violated.

Forward-fill alignment biases sidecars toward their last-known value, suppressing variance and inflating sub_mi_mean (deflating Φ). 4 of 6 sidecars are singletons (1 record), so they contribute ~0 MI but add hash-state diversity.

Joint hash collisions rise nonlinearly with axis count (mod 64 bucket): >32-axis state vectors bucket-collide more than 19-axis; effective H_joint ceiling is log2(64)=6 bits regardless of true entropy.
Memory ledger axes derived from filesystem mtimes, not semantic content; mem_nfiles is monotonic across the observation window so contributes ~0 MI by construction.
MIP surrogate (mean-of-parts) inherits Phase-1 looseness; with 32 axes the inequality slack vs true Tononi-Φ widens combinatorially.
